performance.driver: Revenue from owned hotel rooms decreased $2.2 million, or 14.9%, revenue from managed condominium rooms decreased $4.3 million, or 13.1%, dining revenue decreased $1.1 million, or 7.1%, and transportation revenue decreased $1.5 million, or 22.9%, each primarily due to decreased demand from the impact of decreased skier visitation driven by challenging weather conditions.

Net sales of our animal health and nutrition products in the third quarter of fiscal year 2026 increased $0.6 million, or 10%, compared to the third quarter of fiscal year 2025, driven by higher volumes due to increased demand, including new end-users and partial recovery of sales from a previously lost customer at one of our distributors.
